basic_info.description: Gorgeous home in a sought after area, upper Monterey near the Glen Park Bart Station, Fwy and just minutes to Downtown. Beautifully updated, new flooring throughout, spacious & bright kitchen w/new stainless steel appliances, new quartz countertops, eat-in area, mostly new doors, large one bedroom, formal dinging room or optional second bedroom w/closet, one bath, freshly painted inside & outside, covered deck w/views of beautifully large landscaped backyard with fruit trees including two apple, plum, lemon tree/bush and other small fruit tree, extra large garage w/storage. PLUS downstairs one more bedroom & bath or potential separate studio for extended family, city views from the front porch and much more...
